name: Round Robin Brainstorming

steps.text: Seat a circle; rule: sketch, pass left, build, harden.
Seed zone one with a concept, a headline, and a sketch.
Pass left; add to zone two and never erase or judge.
Pass left; name zone three's biggest failure and patch it.
Return each sheet to its originator and read the chain.

failure: Half-working looks like zone two full of objections: the chain stops evolving and each sheet becomes opinions.
intervention: Say: treat the seed as given, then answer yes-and.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A long-standing group technique for chained iteration; no origin given in the source.
